info.title: willow
info.description: A tool that helps you prune your .NET dependency tree — finds removable transitive PackageReferences, flags risky overrides, classifies internal vs external packages for vulnerability triage, walks reverse dependency paths, cross-references against OSV.dev, and works with classic .sln, .slnx, and Central Package Management. Fork of Snitch by Patrik Svensson (Spectre Systems AB).
